config.basket_source: USDA Food and Nutrition Service, Thrifty Food Plan, 2021 (report FNS-916, August 2021), table 'Thrifty Food Plan Market Basket for the reference family of four, June 2021: aggregate quantities, costs, and cost shares of Market Basket Categories in weekly amounts', report pages 37-38. https://fns-prod.azureedge.us/sites/default/files/resource-files/TFP2021.pdf
config.basket_rule: Each TFP Market Basket Category's weekly pounds go to the basket concepts that represent it. Within a category, pounds are split by U.S. per capita availability (USDA ERS Food Availability Data System, latest year, retail weight where published). Where no public data splits a category, the split is even and marked so. Pounds are then converted to each concept's norm unit.
config.household: USDA reference family of four (man and woman 20-50, children 6-8 and 9-11)
